title: Chapter 11
text:
The Lightweight Mechanical Arm with only 130 durability left, the Enhanced Type 73 WASP, a Wright N9 submachine gun, and 15 clips of ammo. These were all that Han Xiao had. Compared to the well-equipped Owl Squad, it was so shabby that it made his heart ache.

Bang! The sniper rifle fired again. A hot bullet passed through the tree he was hiding in and almost hit him. Han Xiao groaned inwardly. The enemy had night vision goggles, and he could only determine the enemy's position through the muzzle flash.

The sniper rifle was too powerful. With his HP, he would die after three shots. He still had 18 AP. Without thinking, Han Xiao put 14 into END and 4 into STR. The former would save his life, and the latter would ensure that he could deal a crushing blow to the Owl Squad. He had already realized that he had to avoid the enemy's strong points. Although close combat was dangerous, there was a chance. In this situation, trying to escape would only expose his weaknesses. The enemy had night vision goggles. Unless he killed all of them, there was no way to escape!

His STR had reached 29, and with the mechanical arm's + 10 Judgement effect, it was just enough to form a crushing blow. His END had increased to 36, and his HP had increased to 460. After adding the AP, his HP had increased to 140, which was very important. He had regained some HP during the escape, and now his HP was close to 400.

Han Xiao had observed for a while. The Owl Squad had surrounded him in a fan-shaped formation to prevent him from escaping. They did not form close support.

The enemy's sparse formation + the forest environment + the night = five to eight seconds of support interval!

In other words, he only had a few seconds of close combat time. If he could not kill the target he chose, he would definitely be in a desperate situation.

He had killed a lot of enemies in the base. Including his previous savings, he had a total of 116,000 EXP left.

There was nothing to hesitate about in a life and death battle. He put all of his EXP into Close Combat.

Grappling has been leveled up to Lvl 5. Increased Parry and Counterattack by 7%, Unarmed Attack by 10%

Basic Combat has been leveled up to Lvl 8. Increased Unarmed Attack by 8%

[Basic Combat has reached Level 8. Grappling has reached Level 3. Please choose one of the following three advanced skills: Special Combat, Jujitsu, Iron Fist!]

Special combat focused on instantaneous bursts of power, assassination, and the use of weapons. Jiu Jitsu focused on locking techniques and subduing. Steel Fist focused on increasing the strength and resistance of punches and kicks. They represented three different directions of development. What Han Xiao needed the most right now was explosive power.

Advanced Skill Acquired, Special Combat Lvl 1: Increase Critical Strike Rate by 6%, Unarmed Attack by 4%!

After using up all his experience, his melee attack power had increased by nearly 15%. Han Xiao's fighting ability had suddenly improved. He felt that he could instinctively use all kinds of fighting moves very skillfully.

"It's a pity that I don't have any combat-type active skills that can use energy." Han Xiao felt that it was a pity. In the early stages of the Mechanic class, there were very few active skills, so it was very difficult for them to fully utilize their energy. Attribute bonuses were not the main purpose of energy. The true purpose of energy was to use active skills.

Expending energy could allow one to quickly 'recover energy', which was in line with the setting where energy was extracted from one's cells. When to use skills, when to recover energy, and how not to waste any energy were all details that could affect the outcome of a battle.

Han Xiao put on the Lightweight Mechanical Arm. Like a hibernating leopard, he took a deep breath to fill his lungs. Oxygen passed through the alveoli into the blood vessels, passed through the cell membranes, and entered the red blood cells. By increasing the oxygen content of the blood, he adjusted his condition to the peak.

The next moment, Han Xiao suddenly exerted force in his legs and pounced forward like a leopard. He lowered his body and sprinted toward the target he had chosen long ago — the Owl Agent at the very left of the enemy formation, who was closest to him. The moment he jumped out, gunshots rang out. Six Jason submachine guns immediately focused on him and swept across the area, blowing up pieces of soil.

The forest environment was a natural barrier. Han Xiao raised his mechanical arm to block the side of his body and ran around the trees, dodging a large number of bullets. His other hand was holding a submachine gun to suppress the firepower of the Owl Agent. The faint burnt smell of the bullets rubbing against the air rushed into his nose.

Three seconds! Han Xiao rushed to the front of the target and swung the submachine gun out, knocking the muzzle of the Owl Agent. The mechanical arm brazenly struck the Owl Agent's arms, and the sound of bones cracking could be heard. The bones of the arms collided with the metal, and it was obvious that the former was at a disadvantage.

The Owl Agent endured the pain and pulled out his gun, aimed at Han Xiao's head, and fired. Han Xiao's agility was not just for show. He reacted quickly and grabbed the muzzle of the gun with his steel-like hand. With a bang, the bullet was caught in his hand. Han Xiao's right hand clamped the Owl Agent's arm that was holding the gun under his armpit and pulled hard to break the enemy's center of gravity. The Owl Agent stumbled and fell into his arms. At this time, Han Xiao took the opportunity to quickly raise his knee and heavily hit the enemy's lower body. He could clearly feel the two balls deforming under the pressure of his knee.

You have hit the enemy's vital point! Two times the critical hit damage! The enemy will be paralyzed for two seconds!

He could not see the Owl Agent's expression under the goggles, but the scream told him that this attack was very effective. At this critical moment, Han Xiao did not care about whether or not this move was insidious or not. While the enemy was paralyzed, he madly launched a series of knee strikes on the enemy's lower body!

Dong dong dong! 78！- 81！- 84！ The two balls were jumping up and down!

I'm sorry, brother, I can feel your sadness. I didn't design the bulletproof vest …

The enemy's HP drained like water, and Han Xiao's mechanical arm elbowed the enemy's weak throat. The Night Owl Agent fell limply to the ground, and the stench of blood filled his nostrils. Han Xiao guessed that there was a mix of white, yellow, and red in his pants. Before Han Xiao could celebrate, he felt a sharp pain in his back. He hurriedly lay down and hid behind a big tree beside him.

You have been shot in the back by an SWP sniper rifle! You have received 68 damage!

You have been hit by a large caliber bullet and are in a moderate bleeding state. You will lose 3 health points per second for 15 seconds. Please bandage your wounds as soon as possible!

With so many enemies around, there was no time to bandage him!

Han Xiao was in so much pain that his face turned pale. This shot had taken away a lot of his health points. The attack was too strong.

"Damn it!" The remaining five Owl Agents were obviously enraged by Han Xiao's brazen act of killing their comrade. They quickly closed in on him and kept suppressing him. Wood chips flew everywhere, and Han Xiao could not even poke his head out.

Han Xiao looted all the equipment from the Owl Agent's corpse and quickly put on the bulletproof vest. This should be able to block one or two shots for him. The most important thing was the three G-type grenades. These were good stuff. He flicked his hand and threw one out.

"Boom!"

The sound of the explosion rang out, and the enemy hurriedly looked for cover. The suffocating suppressive fire suddenly stopped.

"Shoot me!" Han Xiao was full of resentment. He threw out another grenade, and the five Owl Agents who were about to get up quickly lay down again.

Again! The third black object was thrown out, and the five of them subconsciously lay down. After waiting for two seconds, they found that it did not explode. They looked at it carefully and found that it was not a grenade, but a rock. The five of them immediately understood that they had fallen into a trap. At this time, Han Xiao took the opportunity to rush out and spray with his submachine gun. He did not care that the gun barrel was overheating, and almost instantly, he emptied the magazine. One of the Owl Agents who was hiding in the bushes was turned into a sieve by him.

Han Xiao threw away the submachine gun and turned around to shoot another grenade. Once again, the explosion stopped the remaining four from retaliating. This time, he pounced out like a tiger and knocked over an Owl Agent in another direction. However, this time, he was not unscathed. Silver Knife opened fire in the chaos, and the submachine gun hit his calf, injuring him again.

Han Xiao gritted his teeth. The injury to his calf affected his movement speed. He struggled to drag the Owl Agent who was knocked down by him to the back of a tree and quickly killed him. With his upgraded combat ability, these Owl Agents could not withstand a single blow.

There were only three enemies left! He only had half of his HP left! Facing such a dangerous situation, Han Xiao became calmer and calmer. His mind quickly appeared and eliminated one strategy after another. He had experienced hundreds of battles, and he understood himself and the enemy. No matter what, panic was useless.

"If I'm not wrong, the enemy will …"

Han Xiao's eyes suddenly shrank, and he knew that it was not good.

Yin Dao's face was ashen. At first, he didn't even put this test subject in his eyes. He didn't expect to lose half of his men here. He put away his contempt and also lost his patience. He shouted, "Blow him up!"

The remaining three used their grenades. They drew a beautiful arc and landed behind the tree where Han Xiao was hiding.

"Boom!"

The expanding flames, the roaring sound of the explosion, and the flying dust. When all of this was over, everything returned to silence.

"Is he dead?"

"I'm not sure." Silver Knife shook his head and made a tactical gesture to move forward. The three of them crouched down and slowly moved towards the explosion range.

When they arrived behind the tree, a charred corpse was quietly lying on the ground, emitting white smoke. From the tattered uniform, they could recognize that it was Zero.

"Finally killed him." One of the agents let out a sigh of relief.
